'''Aayu''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Light Sith]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[War against Zakuul|war]] against the [[Eternal Empire]], she was stationed aboard [[Vaiken Spacedock]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Lord Aayu was added to ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' with the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne|''Knights of the Eternal Throne'']] expansion as an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial-side]] vendor for the in-game Galactic Command system.<ref name="SWTOR" />
